title: Zesty Celery Salad
description: A refreshing and healthy side dish that combines the crunch of celery with the zesty flavor of a venezuelan dressing.
instructions: Rinse the celery stalks under cold water and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Cut the celery into 1-inch pieces and place them in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the zesty venezuelan dressing and a pinch of salt.
Pour the dressing over the celery and toss to coat.
Add the mixed greens to the bowl and toss to combine.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
